description: Manual and automated regression prompts for the liquid-glass-design skill.

cases.prompt: Use $liquid-glass-design to upgrade an existing Liquid Glass demo. The screenshot shows the bottom dock overlapping the main card/equalizer, the dock is not visually centered, and the glass feels weak. Keep the existing product context and improve the implementation.
assertions: The response fixes layout hierarchy before tuning optical parameters.
The response preserves the product context instead of replacing the scene with a generic background.
The response verifies dock centering and non-overlap using browser geometry or scripts/check-visual-geometry.mjs.
The response strengthens refraction with measured displacement maps and shape-specific profiles.
The response updates or regenerates any preview image after visual changes.

cases.prompt: Use $liquid-glass-design to create a reusable React LiquidGlass component and showcase page for a premium analytics dashboard.
assertions: The component exposes variant, radius, profile, strength, magnify, dispersion, blur, tint, glare, and interactive props.
The showcase chooses a named composition recipe or equivalent design rationale.
The implementation keeps children sharp and filter SVG nodes out of layout flow.
The showcase exercises small pills, circular/square art, text panels, and a long dock or command rail.
The implementation includes reduced motion, reduced transparency, and fallback behavior.

cases.prompt: Use $liquid-glass-design to review a screenshot of a Liquid Glass interface that looks cluttered, blurry, and low-end. Identify what is wrong and patch the code.
assertions: The review orders issues by composition, geometry, optical material, foreground clarity, accessibility, performance, and fallback.
The patch removes scattered or competing glass samples before adding stronger effects.
The optical changes avoid blur-only glass and use rim refraction plus restrained chromatic detail.
The final answer includes screenshot or runnable-demo verification.
The final answer does not claim success without measurable checks for overlap or clipping.
